chapter.verse: Topa tungah lungdamna ko-in, ama minphat un la, ama nasepnate, mite lakah kitheisak un!
Ama tungah la sa un la, ama tungah phatna la sa un, a lamdang ama nasepte khempeuh gen un!
Ama min siangtho sungah lungdam un la, Topa a zong mite lungdam ta hen!
Topa leh ama hatna zong un la, ama mai a tawntungin zong un!
No ama nasem ahi, Abraham suan-le-khak, Jokob’ tate, ama teel mite aw, ama sepsa a lamdang nate, ama nalamdang lahte, a kam tawh ama thukhennate phawk un!
Amah in Topa i Pasian ahi hi; ama thupiaknate leitung khempeuh ading ahi hi.

“Na luah dingin Kanaan gam ka hong pia ding hi,” ci-a Abraham tawh thuciam a bawlsa, Isaak tunga a thuciamsa, Jakob tungah thupiakna a kipsak, Israel tunga tawntung thuciamna, ama thupiaksa kammal, ama thuciamna pen, khang tulkhat dongin amah in phawk ngitnget hi.
Amaute tawm mahmah-in, bangmah gentham lo uh a, khualmi hi-in,
minam khat panin minam khatah gam khat panin gam khatah a vak kawikawi lai takun,
amah in amaute kuamah nen’niamsak lo hi; amaute hangin amah in kumpite thuhilhin,
“Ka sathau nilhte sukha kei un, ka kamsangte tungah siatna bawl kei un!” ci hi.
Amah in leitungah kialpi tungsakin, an khempeuh a siatsak ciangin,
amah in, Josef a kici, sila-a kizuak mi khat, amaute mai-ah a sawl hi.
Ama khete pen kolte in nasak a, ama ngawng pen sikkol sungah kikoih hi;
ama thugente a tun’ matengin Topa in amah ze-et hi.
Kumpipa in amah khahkhia dingin mi paisak a, mihingte a ukpa in amah khah hi;
ama uliante pen’ Josef in ama ut bangin lam lakin, a upate pen pilna hilhsak a, ama inn sung Topa leh ama neihsa khempeuh a ukpa-in amah koih hi.
Tua ciangin Izipt gamah Israel a pai hi; Ham’ gam sungah Jakob peemta-in va om hi.
Topa in ama mite pungsak mahmah a, a galte sangin amaute hatzaw sak hi.
Ama mite mudahin, ama nasemte, khemsiamna tawh a bawl dingin, amau lungsim uh amah in kiheisak hi.
Amah in, ama nasem Moses leh ama teelsa Aaron sawl hi.
Amaute in, ama limte amaute lakah, nalamdangte, Ham’ gam sungah bawl uh hi.
Amah in khuamial sawlin, leitung khimzing sak hi; ahih hangin Izipt mite in ama thu langpang uh hi.
Amah in amau’ tuite sisan suak sak a, a ngasate uh sisak hi.
Amau’ leitang tung leh amau kumpipa inn sung nangawn, uiphukte tawh kidim hi.
Amah kam pau a, tho honpite leh thokangte, gam sung khempeuh ah hong om hi.
Amah in amau’ guah dingin gialpi leh amau gam sung khempeuh a taangsak khuaphialep, amaute pia hi.
Amah in amau’ leengguite leh theikungte vattansak a, amau gamsung singte kuaihtansak hi.
Amah kam pau a, kauphete leh tangngolte, sim zawh lohin hong pai uh a,
gam sunga kung khempeuh leh amau leitang pan-a a gah khempeuh nektum sak mang hi.
Amah in, amau thahatna pan-a a piang masa, Izipt mi tacil khempeuh satlum hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, ngun leh kham tawh Israelte paikhiatpih a, amaute a vekpi-in cidamin thahat kim uh hi.
Amaute a paikhiat ciangun Izipt mite lungdam mahmah uh hi, bang hang hiam cih leh amaute kihta uh hi.
Amah in, a liah dingin meiipi kaaisak a, zan ciangin khuamuh nadingin mei om sak hi.
Amaute in ngen a, amah in, vamimte leh vantung panin anlum tampi a pia hi.
Amah in suangpi hong a, tui phulkhia hi; guntui bangin sehnel gamah a luang hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh a siangtho ama thuciamna leh ama nasem Abraham a phawk hi.
Tua ahih ciangin, ama mite lungdamna tawh, ama teel mite lasakna tawh a paikhiatpih hi.
Amaute in ama ngeina kipte zui-in, ama thukhamte a neih theih nadingin, amah in, amaute tungah minamte’ leitang pia a, mite’ nasepna gahte zong a ngahsak hi. Topa phat un!
